advancement.servus_manufacturing.journal: Experience is the master. Chapters of the journal, finished by doing alchemy
book.servus_manufacturing.journal.name: Paracelsus' Journal
book.servus_manufacturing.journal.opus.p: These are the notes of Theophrastus von Hohenheim, who called himself Paracelsus.
I learned from the furnace, the mine and the sickbed, not from old books. Experience is the master. Follow these pages by doing the work, and each chapter of my life will open to you.
book.servus_manufacturing.journal.opus.s: In the silver mines of Schwaz in Tyrol I worked among the miners and saw the sickness the mountain gives them.
The old miners say that metals grow in the rock like plants, and that small spirits of the earth live in the galleries. If the mountain grows its ores, perhaps it can be asked to.
Salt is the body of all things. Press nine Salt Crystals into a block, eight such blocks into a ring around your Athanor, and its flame turns white: Albedo.
The spirits of the earth live in the rock as we live in air, and common eyes do not see them. On a white Athanor, Quicksilver and the three principles give the Elixir of Sight.
The miners of Schwaz say the metals grow in the mountain like roots, tended by gnomes.
Burn cracked stone bricks with Salt and Mercury on a white Athanor into a Gnome Hollow, give it a sample of ore, and feed it Salt and Mercury until the vein is ripe.

Then drink the elixir and offer a Salt Crystal: a gnome takes it and digs that ore for you, for as long as the Hollow stands.

To go on: finish one craft on an Albedo Athanor, drink the Elixir of Sight, and bind a gnome.
book.servus_manufacturing.journal.opus.v: Every alchemist needs a furnace that never goes out. Build an Athanor of bricks, a blast furnace and a cauldron.

Lay an item on it and feed it principles by bucket or pipe; it burns them into something new.

The stones you set around it decide how far its fire reaches. Alone it burns black, the fire of Nigredo.
My father was a physician in Villach, in Carinthia, a country of mines and smelters. There I first watched ore turn into metal in the fire.

Every body is made of three: Salt, which gives it form, Sulfur, which burns, and Mercury, the spirit that flies off. Burn a thing in the Calciner and the three part from each other.

Join them again in the Coagulator.

To finish this chapter:

- Calcine 100 things
- Gather 1,000 mB of Salt
- Coagulate your first Salt Crystal
Your team shares this work. See your progress with /servus_manufacturing journal.
Finishing Villach opens the next chapter of the journal: Schwaz, and the mines.
book.servus_manufacturing.journal.toolti: Notes of Theophrastus von Hohenheim. Experience is the master.
book.servus_manufacturing.journal.worksh: The furnace that never goes out
Use an item on it to lay it on top. Pour principle buckets on it, or lead pipes to it.
Its Fire
Alone its flame is black: Nigredo. Eight Salt Crystal Blocks in a ring around it, on its own level, turn the flame white: Albedo. Some works need the white fire.
Lay an item on it, feed it principles, and it burns them into something new.
The Athanor
The Athanor
Bricks, a cauldron and a blast furnace.

- Blaze Powder from Gunpowder: 200 Sulfur
- Bottle o' Enchanting from Glass Bottle: 50 Salt, 100 Mercury (Albedo)
- Elixir of Sight from Quicksilver: 100 Salt, 100 Sulfur, 250 Mercury (Albedo)
Its Works
- Gnome Hollow from Cracked Stone Bricks: 500 Salt, 250 Mercury (Albedo)
A wall one block deep with a tank on each side. Press Visualize, then click the ground where it shall stand.
The Calciner

- Cobblestone: 100 Salt, 10 Mercury
- Stone: 100 Salt, 10 Mercury
- Dirt: 50 Salt, 20 Sulfur, 20 Mercury
- Sand: 80 Salt, 10 Mercury
- Gravel: 80 Salt, 10 Mercury
What Burns

- Logs: 20 Salt, 100 Sulfur, 10 Mercury
- Planks: 5 Salt, 25 Sulfur
- Leaves: 40 Sulfur, 20 Mercury
- Saplings: 40 Sulfur, 20 Mercury
- Crops: 10 Salt, 30 Sulfur, 30 Mercury
- Seeds: 10 Salt, 30 Sulfur, 30 Mercury

- Coal: 200 Sulfur
- Raw ore: 150 Salt, 50 Mercury
- Redstone: 100 Mercury
- Bones: 100 Salt
Burn matter into its principles
Each principle leaves where it belongs. Salt stays behind as ash in the Ash Pan.
Taking Them Out
Mercury drips through the Receiver into the right tank, and Sulfur rises into the Hood and runs down the duct into the left tank.

Take them from the tanks with a bucket, or with a pipe whose side at the tank you set to pull in with the carrot: a tank on a plain side only ever fills.

The Salt waits in the Ash Pan for a bucket, a pipe or a tank.
Hand the matter to the mouth, or let a hopper or a pipe feed it. Coal and other fuel go into the Firebox below; one coal burns for several items.
Firing It

Sneak with an empty hand at the mouth to take the matter back.

When a principle has no room left, the Calciner waits.
My furnace for the first work. It burns a thing until only its three principles are left.
The Calciner
The Calciner
The furnace is bricks around three parts stacked in the middle: the Ash Pan at the bottom, the Firebox above it and the Calciner, the mouth, above that.
The Parts
On top of the mouth sits the Alembic, the copper still, and the Sulfur Hood crowns it. Beside the furnace stand two columns of three Fluid Tanks.
The Receiver sits on the right column and catches what drips from the still's spout; keep the gap under the spout free. The Sulfur Duct leads from the Hood down into the left column.
The mouth with its cauldron, and the Firebox.
The Sulfur Duct, three at once.
The Ash Pan and the Alembic.
The Receiver and the Sulfur Hood.
When every block stands, use this journal on the Calciner. The bricks join and the furnace becomes one thing. If something is missing, the journal tells you what and where.
Waking It
Break any block and the furnace falls apart into its bricks and parts again.
Join the principles into a body
Press the select button and choose what to make. Then bring the principles: by pipe into its sides, or pour a bucket on the block or on a gauge.
Joining
Each principle finds its own tank. A side set to one principle in the Fluids tab takes only that one.
It joins the principles again into a body. It needs no fire, only time to cool.
The Coagulator

- Salt Crystal: 250 Salt
- Sulfur: 250 Sulfur
- Quicksilver: 250 Mercury
- Clay Ball: 100 Salt, 50 Mercury
- Flint: 150 Salt
What It Makes

- Gunpowder: 50 Salt, 150 Sulfur
- Redstone: 50 Salt, 150 Mercury
- Glowstone Dust: 100 Sulfur, 100 Mercury
- Bone Meal: 60 Salt, 20 Sulfur
- Slimeball: 50 Sulfur, 150 Mercury
The Coagulator
Iron, glass, a cauldron and redstone.
Lay Quicksilver on a white Athanor and feed it 100 Salt, 100 Sulfur, 250 Mercury.
Brewing It
Albedo: see what lives in the rock
Drink it and for a few minutes you see the spirits of the earth and what they tend.
Elixir of Sight
Elixir of Sight
Albedo: a vein that grows
Put a raw ore or an ore block into its sample slot. Feed it Salt and Mercury by pipe or bucket, and step by step the vein ripens.
Growing a Vein
When it is ripe, drink the Elixir of Sight and use a Salt Crystal on the Hollow. A gnome takes it and digs that ore for you, as long as the Hollow stands.
A home for a gnome. To common eyes it is only stone.
Gnome Hollow
Lay Cracked Stone Bricks on a white Athanor and feed it 500 Salt, 250 Mercury.
Making It
Gnome Hollow
Workshop
A Fluid Pipe moves principles between blocks. Every pipe arm that touches a block has a channel colour, and only arms of the same channel trade.
Pipes and Channels
Set the channel with the carrot on the arm that touches the block.
Where each principle goes
Pipes and Sides
A machine side has two settings. The Items tab says what items do there. The Fluids tab says which principle goes in or out: Off, All, or one principle.
Sides

The carrot works on one of them; use it on the air to switch between Items and Fluids.

The Calciner has no sides to set: each principle leaves through its own part.
Salt, Sulfur and Mercury
A Fluid Tank holds one principle at a time, so give each principle its own tank.
Keeping Them
Poured on the ground they spread like water but never make a new source. What you do not need, pour into a Sink.
The Three Principles
Every body is made of three. Salt gives it form, Sulfur makes it burn, and Mercury is the spirit that flies off.
The Three
In this work they are liquids. They flow through Fluid Pipes, rest in Fluid Tanks and fill buckets.
Nine Salt Crystals pressed together. Eight of them around the Athanor make its flame white.
Salt Crystal Block
Albedo: the white ring
Salt Crystal Block
Nine Salt Crystals from the Coagulator.
